INTERNAL ALPHA

Welcome to Kwalitec

A short orientation — 6 ideas, then Study Sensei guides your study.

Step 1 of 6

What Kwalitec is

Kwalitec is an Education Operating System for demanding exams. It is the product that hosts your Study Plan, Sessions, and progress — calmly, from your plan and your evidence.

Step 2 of 6

Meet Study Sensei

Study Sensei is how Kwalitec guides your daily learning decisions. After this orientation, Study Sensei is your educational mentor for what to focus on, why it matters, and what comes next.

Step 3 of 6

How Missions work

Each day Study Sensei prepares one focused Mission — what deserves your attention now. Start today's Session to practice that Mission, then record what you did. Missions keep study decisions small so learning can stay large.

Step 4 of 6

Why recommendations are explainable

Recommendations come from your syllabus structure, available time, and study history — not a black box. When you expand “why”, you see the reasons Study Sensei used.

Step 5 of 6

How Reflections work

Reflection after a Session closes practice. Commitment reflection on Home confirms you finished what you chose. Optional reflection in the Decision Journal helps the Study Sensei learn whether guidance was useful. The Educational Timeline asks deeper questions about your learning story. Product Check-in is feedback for the product team — not educational reflection. Help keeps this map whenever you need it.

Step 6 of 6

How Study Sensei remembers

The Decision Journal is Study Sensei’s durable educational memory of significant guidance, your choices, and what followed. The Educational Timeline is the chronological learning story drawn from that Journal — not a second memory store and not a scoreboard. History keeps practice archives and progress stats as context; educational meaning lives in the Journal and Timeline. After a Reflection, Session notes stay with the Session; optional Sensei reflection deepens Journal memory that Timeline can later interpret. Help keeps this memory map whenever you need it.

Each day Study Sensei prepares one focused Mission — what deserves your attention now. Start today's Session to practice that Mission, then record what you did. Missions keep study decisions small so learning can stay large.

Step 4 of 6

Why recommendations are explainable

Recommendations come from your syllabus structure, available time, and study history — not a black box. When you expand “why”, you see the reasons Study Sensei used.

Step 5 of 6

How Reflections work

Reflection after a Session closes practice. Commitment reflection on Home confirms you finished what you chose. Optional reflection in the Decision Journal helps the Study Sensei learn whether guidance was useful. The Educational Timeline asks deeper questions about your learning story. Product Check-in is feedback for the product team — not educational reflection. Help keeps this map whenever you need it.

Step 6 of 6

How Study Sensei remembers

The Decision Journal is Study Sensei’s durable educational memory of significant guidance, your choices, and what followed. The Educational Timeline is the chronological learning story drawn from that Journal — not a second memory store and not a scoreboard. History keeps practice archives and progress stats as context; educational meaning lives in the Journal and Timeline. After a Reflection, Session notes stay with the Session; optional Sensei reflection deepens Journal memory that Timeline can later interpret. Help keeps this memory map whenever you need it.

ORIENTATION

Your educational journey

Study Sensei is how Kwalitec guides your daily learning decisions. Kwalitec is the product; Study Sensei is your educational mentor for what to focus on, why it matters, and what comes next.

Mission — what deserves your attention today.
Study Session — the practice workflow for that Mission.
Reflection — a short pause that closes practice or calibrates guidance (see the Reflection map below).
Decision Journal — Study Sensei’s durable educational memory of significant guidance and your choices.
Educational Timeline — the chronological learning story drawn from the Journal — not a second memory store.
History — practice archives and progress stats as context; meaning lives in Journal and Timeline.
Study Sensei — the mentor voice across Mission, Session, Journal, Timeline, and guidance that History only bridges to.

EDUCATIONAL MEMORY

One educational memory system

The Decision Journal is Study Sensei’s durable educational memory of significant guidance, your choices, and what followed. The Educational Timeline is the chronological learning story drawn from that Journal — not a second memory store and not a scoreboard. History keeps practice archives and progress stats as context; educational meaning lives in the Journal and Timeline. After a Reflection, Session notes stay with the Session; optional Sensei reflection deepens Journal memory that Timeline can later interpret.

REFLECTION

One reflection family

Reflection after a Session closes practice. Commitment reflection on Home confirms you finished what you chose. Optional reflection in the Decision Journal helps the Study Sensei learn whether guidance was useful. The Educational Timeline asks deeper questions about your learning story. Product Check-in is feedback for the product team — not educational reflection.

Session reflection — closes practice after a Session; optional note; does not score you.
Commitment reflection — on Home after you finish what you chose.
Sensei reflection — optional questions in the Decision Journal about whether guidance helped.
Timeline reflection — deeper questions on the Educational Timeline about your learning story.
Guided Reflection preview — Home prompts to think through only; nothing is recorded.
Not reflection: Product Check-in (product research), Calibration (declared coverage), Revision (review practice).
